home.title: International Analysis of Sustainability Policy Implementation in HEIs 2026
home.intro: Welcome to the interactive results platform of MetaRed S. This report visualizes the current state of sustainability, social and environmental responsibility policies of 131 Ibero-American Higher Education Institutions (HEIs), along with their interactive catalogue of Good Practices registered in the knowledge space.

credits.intro: This analysis has been prepared thanks to the collaboration of coordinators and technical sustainability teams from MetaRed university networks across Ibero-America. We appreciate their commitment to reporting and promoting environmental sustainability, governance and inclusion in higher education institutions.

q.amb_sub_1: Does the University have programmes or projects that promote the use of natural renewable energy?
q.amb_sub_2: Does the University have plans, projects and actions aimed at the rational and efficient use of energy?
q.amb_sub_3: Does the University have plans, projects and actions to reduce greenhouse gas emissions?
q.amb_sub_4: Does the University have plans, projects and actions for the rational and sustainable use of water?
q.amb_sub_5: Does the University have plans, projects and actions to promote the use of reusable materials and eliminate single-use or disposable materials?
q.amb_sub_6: Does the University have plans, projects and actions to promote comprehensive waste management generated by its activities?
q.amb_sub_7: Does the University have plans, projects and actions to protect local biodiversity?
q.amb_sub_8: Does the University promote awareness among the university community regarding environmental responsibility in personal habits or best practices?
q.amb_sub_9: Does the University have specific actions to promote the reduction of food waste in cafeterias, canteens, dining halls and/or cafeterias?
q.amb_sub_10: Does the University promote sustainable mobility?
q.soc_sub_1: Does the University have support programmes for low-income students?
q.soc_sub_2: Does the University develop policies and programmes related to cooperation and community development topics?
q.soc_sub_3: Does the University develop research policies and agreements with key stakeholders to promote local community development?
q.soc_sub_4: Does the University develop policies for constant evaluation and systematisation to improve the contribution of community extension activities?
q.soc_sub_5: Does the University develop internal policies for promoting and evaluating Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) in its management?
q.soc_sub_6: Does the University develop programmes or actions to promote health care and well-being within the university community?
q.soc_sub_7: Does the University promote research on sustainable development and/or social responsibility?
q.soc_sub_8: Does the University promote the development of entrepreneurship, innovation and the fostering of start-ups?
q.soc_sub_9: Does the University promote continuous training of technical, administrative and service staff?
q.soc_sub_10: Does the University promote social and environmental volunteering?
q.soc_sub_11: Does the University encourage the improvement of universal accessibility, including digital accessibility?
q.soc_sub_12: Does the University have tools or mechanisms to facilitate the reconciliation of personal, family and professional life?
q.soc_sub_13: Does the University have policies, programmes or actions that facilitate and encourage the integration of people with functional diversity?
q.soc_sub_14: Does the University have mechanisms or organisational structures that allow effective student participation in governing bodies?
q.soc_sub_15: Does the University have transparent hiring and remuneration policies?
q.soc_sub_16: Does the University have policies for evaluating teaching activity and the quality of education provided?
q.soc_sub_17: Does the University develop policies of respect for human rights?
q.soc_sub_18: Does the University develop pre-professional internship and labour insertion programmes?
q.gob_1: Does the University invite external stakeholders to participate in the definition of its mission, vision and strategic planning?
q.gob_2: Is there an explicit commitment to sustainability and/or social responsibility in the University's strategic planning?
q.gob_3: Does the University have a management dashboard (or similar) with sustainability performance information?
q.gob_4: Is there an accessible document establishing the ethical commitment of the University towards all its stakeholders?
q.gob_5: Does the University have an Institutional Development Plan or Strategic Plan that includes sustainability criteria?
q.gob_6: Does the University have mechanisms to detect fraud, conflicts of interest, corruption and other forms of misconduct?
q.gob_7: Does the University have a department or responsible person who ensures compliance with sustainability commitments?
q.gob_8: Does the University have a Good Governance Code or an explicit commitment to anti-corruption policies?
q.gob_9: Does the University have policies, guidelines, programmes, procedures or actions to ensure the safety of its community members?
q.gob_10: Does the University have an Internal Audit Committee?
q.gob_11: Does the University have mechanisms and/or risk assessment initiatives for the activities it carries out?
q.gob_12: Does the University have bodies, mechanisms or policies that promote equality and non-discrimination?
q.gob_13: Does the University have bodies, mechanisms or policies that promote inclusion and diversity?
q.gob_14: Does the University incorporate social, environmental or sustainability aspects and/or criteria into its purchasing and contracting process?
q.gob_15: Does the University encourage the incorporation of social responsibility and/or sustainability into teaching content?
q.gob_16: Does the University have mechanisms to develop an ongoing dialogue with its stakeholders?
q.gob_17: Is the University included in any sustainability-related ranking?
q.gob_18: Is the University a signatory of the UN Global Compact?
q.gob_19: Does the University publish concrete data on its performance in relation to the SDGs?
q.gob_20: Does the University have a Committee, Commission or Council composed of representatives of different stakeholders to coordinate sustainability actions?
q.gob_21: Does the University disclose its organisational chart and the composition of its governing bodies?
q.gob_22: Does the University have a Transparency Portal that publishes relevant information for all stakeholders?
